0|2d13bafeba24f732e89b818b8c66b07893457570|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"net: Make it easier to parse /proc/net/dev contents.
The contents of /proc/net/dev is annoying to parse
it changes whether there is a space after the ""ethX:"" or not.
It depends upon the size of the ""Receive bytes"" counter
if the number is below 7 digits
else if the number is 8 digits or above there is no space
This patch changes the output to assure there is always a space
between the "":"" and the number.  Given that all existing userspace
application already need to handle the whitespaces
